brave|apply_all_debloat.why: Applies every Brave setting on this page in one go.
brave|apply_all_debloat.gain: All the Brave clean-up and security settings at once.
brave|apply_all_debloat.cost: Everything the individual switches cost: no Rewards, Wallet, VPN, Leo, Sync, saved passwords or autofill.
brave|apply_all_debloat.note: Set by policy: Brave shows 'Managed by your organization'.

brave|disable_ai_chat.why: Leo AI chat adds a sidebar and sends page content to Brave's servers when used.

brave|disable_autofill_address.gain: Addresses aren't stored in the browser.

brave|disable_autofill_card.why: Brave can store and fill payment cards.
brave|disable_autofill_card.gain: Card numbers aren't stored in the browser.

brave|disable_background_mode.why: Brave can keep running after you close it.
brave|disable_background_mode.cost: Extensions and notifications don't run while Brave is closed.

brave|disable_error_pages.why: Brave uses a web service to suggest fixes for unreachable pages.

brave|disable_metrics.why: Chromium can send usage and crash reports.
brave|disable_metrics.gain: No metrics or crash reports sent.
brave|disable_metrics.cost: Brave gets less crash information to fix bugs.

brave|disable_network_prediction.why: Brave preloads pages it thinks you'll open.
brave|disable_network_prediction.gain: Less network traffic and fewer requests to sites you never visit.
brave|disable_network_prediction.cost: Pages you were about to open may load a little slower.

brave|disable_password_manager.gain: No save-password prompts; use a dedicated password manager instead.
brave|disable_password_manager.cost: Saved Brave passwords aren't filled in.

brave|disable_rewards.why: Brave Rewards shows ads and runs a crypto wallet for BAT.
brave|disable_rewards.gain: No Rewards ads or background tasks.
brave|disable_rewards.cost: You can't earn or send BAT.

brave|disable_search_suggest.why: What you type in the address bar is sent to the search engine for suggestions.
brave|disable_search_suggest.gain: Keystrokes stay private until you press Enter.

brave|disable_stats_ping.why: Brave sends an anonymous daily usage ping.

brave|disable_sync.why: Brave Sync shares bookmarks and settings between devices.
brave|disable_sync.cost: Bookmarks and passwords don't sync to your other devices.

brave|disable_wallet.gain: Wallet UI and its background service are gone.
brave|disable_wallet.cost: You can't use the built-in wallet.

brave|enable_https_only.why: Some sites still load over unencrypted HTTP.
brave|enable_https_only.gain: Every page loads over HTTPS or shows a warning first.
brave|enable_https_only.cost: An extra click for the few sites that only work over HTTP.

brave|enable_safe_browsing.why: Safe Browsing checks sites and downloads against a malware list.
brave|enable_safe_browsing.gain: Warnings before dangerous sites and downloads.
brave|enable_safe_browsing.cost: Lookups are made to Google's Safe Browsing service.

brave|set_homepage_newtab.why: Sets the home button to the New Tab page.
brave|set_homepage_newtab.cost: Any custom home page is replaced.

brave|set_restore_newtab.why: Brave can restore your last session on startup.
brave|set_restore_newtab.gain: Starts clean with a new tab.

contextmenu|cast_to_device.why: Removes 'Cast to device' from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|cast_to_device.cost: 'Cast to device' is no longer available from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|cast_to_device.who: Users who never use 'Cast to device'.

contextmenu|cmd_here.gain: A Command Prompt opened in that folder.

contextmenu|copy_path.why: Adds 'Copy as path' without holding Shift.
contextmenu|copy_path.gain: Copy a file's full path in one click.

contextmenu|copy_to_folder.why: Removes 'Copy to folder' from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|copy_to_folder.cost: 'Copy to folder' is no longer available from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|copy_to_folder.who: Users who never use 'Copy to folder'.

contextmenu|give_access_to.why: Removes 'Give access to' from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|give_access_to.cost: 'Give access to' is no longer available from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|give_access_to.who: Users who never use 'Give access to'.

contextmenu|move_to_folder.why: Removes 'Move to folder' from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|move_to_folder.cost: 'Move to folder' is no longer available from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|move_to_folder.who: Users who never use 'Move to folder'.

contextmenu|new_bing_search.why: Search sends what you type to Bing.

contextmenu|notepad.why: Adds 'Open with Notepad' to every file.
contextmenu|notepad.gain: Open any file in Notepad in one click.
contextmenu|notepad.cost: One more menu entry on every file.

contextmenu|pin_start.why: Removes 'Pin to Start' from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|pin_start.cost: 'Pin to Start' is no longer available from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|pin_start.who: Users who never use 'Pin to Start'.

contextmenu|pin_taskbar.why: Removes 'Pin to taskbar' from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|pin_taskbar.cost: 'Pin to taskbar' is no longer available from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|pin_taskbar.who: Users who never use 'Pin to taskbar'.

contextmenu|powershell_here.gain: A PowerShell window opened in that folder.

contextmenu|previous_versions.why: Removes 'Previous versions' from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|previous_versions.cost: 'Previous versions' is no longer available from the right-click menu.

contextmenu|print.cost: 'Print' is no longer available from the right-click menu.

contextmenu|scan_defender.why: Removes 'Scan with Microsoft Defender' from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|scan_defender.cost: 'Scan with Microsoft Defender' is no longer available from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|scan_defender.who: Users who never use 'Scan with Microsoft Defender'.

contextmenu|send_to.why: Removes 'Send to' from the right-click menu.
contextmenu|send_to.cost: 'Send to' is no longer available from the right-click menu.

contextmenu|share.cost: 'Share' is no longer available from the right-click menu.

contextmenu|show_more_options.why: Windows 11 hides most entries behind 'Show more options'.
contextmenu|show_more_options.gain: The full right-click menu opens straight away.
contextmenu|show_more_options.note: Same setting as 'Use the classic right-click menu' on the File Explorer page.

contextmenu|take_ownership.why: Adds 'Take ownership' to files and folders.
contextmenu|take_ownership.gain: Fix 'access denied' files in one click (asks for admin).
contextmenu|take_ownership.cost: Taking ownership of system files can break Windows features; use it only on your own files.

gaming|disable_fullscreen_optimizations.why: Windows runs 'fullscreen' games as optimized borderless windows.
gaming|disable_fullscreen_optimizations.gain: Real exclusive fullscreen in older games, which some players prefer.
gaming|disable_fullscreen_optimizations.cost: Alt-Tab is slower and overlays may not work.

gaming|disable_game_bar.why: Xbox Game Bar is an overlay that opens with Win+G.
gaming|disable_game_bar.gain: No overlay or its background process.
gaming|disable_game_bar.cost: No Game Bar widgets, performance overlay or Xbox party chat.
gaming|disable_game_bar.who: Users who don't use Game Bar.

gaming|disable_game_dvr.why: Game DVR can record in the background.
gaming|disable_game_dvr.who: Everyone who records with other tools.

gaming|disable_hpet.why: Stops Windows forcing the HPET timer and turns off the dynamic tick.
gaming|disable_hpet.cost: Results vary; higher idle power use.
gaming|disable_hpet.who: Desktop users who test the difference.

gaming|disable_memory_integrity.why: Memory Integrity checks drivers through the hypervisor.
gaming|disable_memory_integrity.gain: Can raise game performance a few percent.
gaming|disable_memory_integrity.who: Gaming PCs where you accept less protection.
gaming|disable_memory_integrity.note: Some anti-cheat systems and Windows 11 security baselines expect it on.

gaming|disable_prefetch.why: Prefetch preloads files of apps you use often.
gaming|disable_prefetch.cost: Apps start more slowly; on SSDs the gain is negligible.

gaming|disable_spectre_meltdown.why: Spectre and Meltdown fixes cost some CPU performance, mainly on older CPUs.
gaming|disable_spectre_meltdown.gain: A few percent more speed in some workloads.
gaming|disable_spectre_meltdown.cost: Your PC becomes vulnerable to these CPU attacks, including from websites.
gaming|disable_spectre_meltdown.note: Same setting as the one on the Windows page.

gaming|disable_tpm.why: Credential Guard isolates sign-in secrets with virtualization.
gaming|disable_tpm.cost: Stolen-credential attacks get easier on domain/work PCs.
gaming|disable_tpm.note: This doesn't turn off the TPM chip itself.

gaming|disable_vbs.why: Virtualization-based security runs part of Windows in a hypervisor.
gaming|disable_vbs.gain: Can raise game performance a few percent.
gaming|disable_vbs.cost: Removes protection against kernel malware; Memory Integrity and Credential Guard stop working.
gaming|disable_vbs.who: Gaming PCs where you accept less protection.
gaming|disable_vbs.note: Same setting as 'Disable virtualization-based security' on the Windows page.

gaming|enable_vrr.why: Turns on Windows' variable refresh rate for windowed games.
gaming|enable_vrr.gain: Smoother frame pacing on G-Sync/FreeSync monitors.
gaming|enable_vrr.cost: Can cause flicker on some monitors.

gaming|game_mode.why: Game Mode gives the game priority and pauses Windows Update installs while you play.
gaming|game_mode.cost: Rarely, some games stutter with it; it's on by default in Windows 11.

gaming|hags.why: Lets the graphics card manage its own memory scheduling.
gaming|hags.gain: Can lower latency and CPU load; needed for DLSS Frame Generation.
gaming|hags.cost: Some older games or capture tools behave worse.

gaming|msi_mode.why: Message Signaled Interrupts can lower interrupt latency for the GPU and network card.
gaming|msi_mode.gain: Possibly lower latency on devices that support it.
gaming|msi_mode.cost: A device that doesn't handle MSI properly can stop working or stop the PC from booting.
gaming|msi_mode.who: Experienced users who can boot into Safe Mode.

gaming|optimize_games.why: The dynamic tick lets the timer stop while idle to save power.
gaming|optimize_games.cost: Higher idle power use; results vary.
gaming|optimize_games.who: Desktop users who test the difference.

gaming|timer_resolution.why: Changes how Windows keeps time to reduce timer jitter.
gaming|timer_resolution.gain: Some players report more consistent input timing.
gaming|timer_resolution.cost: Results vary by PC and can make things worse; needs a restart to test.
gaming|timer_resolution.who: Experienced users who benchmark before and after.

gpu|disable_defender.why: Microsoft Defender scans files as you use them.
gpu|disable_defender.cost: No real-time malware protection unless another antivirus is installed. Tamper Protection usually blocks this.
gpu|disable_defender.note: Same setting as on the Windows page.

gpu|disable_firewall.why: The firewall blocks unwanted incoming connections.
gpu|disable_firewall.gain: Hosting tools work without firewall rules.
gpu|disable_firewall.cost: Anything on your network can reach services on your PC.
gpu|disable_firewall.who: Only PCs behind another firewall, for troubleshooting.

gpu|disable_fullscreen_opt.why: Windows runs 'fullscreen' games as optimized borderless windows.
gpu|disable_fullscreen_opt.gain: Real exclusive fullscreen in older games.
gpu|disable_fullscreen_opt.cost: Alt-Tab is slower and overlays may not work.
gpu|disable_fullscreen_opt.note: Same setting as on the Gaming page.

gpu|disable_fxaa.why: Sets a feature-control flag for post-process anti-aliasing.
gpu|disable_fxaa.note: Current graphics drivers don't read this value; set anti-aliasing in your driver panel.

gpu|disable_gpu_power_save.why: Sets the power plan's graphics preference to performance.
gpu|disable_gpu_power_save.gain: The GPU is less likely to clock down on switchable-graphics laptops.

gpu|disable_gpu_timeout.why: Windows resets the graphics driver if the GPU stops responding for 2 seconds.
gpu|disable_gpu_timeout.gain: Heavy workloads get 8 seconds before a reset, avoiding false 'driver stopped responding' errors.
gpu|disable_gpu_timeout.cost: A real GPU hang takes longer to recover from.

gpu|disable_logon_blur.why: The sign-in screen blurs its background.

gpu|disable_mouse_accel.why: Enhance pointer precision makes pointer distance depend on mouse speed.
gpu|disable_mouse_accel.cost: Low-DPI mice may need a higher pointer speed.

gpu|disable_multiplane_overlay.why: MPO is a display feature linked to flicker and stutter on some setups.
gpu|disable_multiplane_overlay.gain: Can fix flicker or black screens in some multi-monitor setups.
gpu|disable_multiplane_overlay.note: Recent Windows builds may ignore this value.

gpu|disable_outlook_new.why: Classic Outlook shows a 'Try the new Outlook' switch.
gpu|disable_outlook_new.gain: The switch is hidden so you stay on classic Outlook.

gpu|disable_rdp_warnings.why: Remote Desktop warns before redirecting drives or devices.
gpu|disable_rdp_warnings.gain: No warning dialog when you connect.
gpu|disable_rdp_warnings.cost: You won't be warned when connecting to an unknown server with drive redirection.
gpu|disable_rdp_warnings.who: Users who only connect to their own PCs.

gpu|disable_remote_assist.cost: You can't connect to this PC with Remote Desktop.

gpu|disable_s0_network.why: Modern Standby can keep the network on while asleep.
gpu|disable_s0_network.cost: No email or updates while the laptop sleeps.

gpu|disable_settings_home.why: The Settings Home page shows promotions and recommendations.
gpu|disable_settings_home.gain: Settings opens on a normal page.

gpu|disable_storage_sense.why: Storage Sense deletes temporary files and Recycle Bin items on a schedule.
gpu|disable_storage_sense.gain: Nothing is deleted without you asking.
gpu|disable_storage_sense.cost: Temporary files build up until you clean them (the Cleaner tool can do that).
gpu|disable_storage_sense.who: Users who clean up by hand.

gpu|disable_tray_notifications.why: Removes the notification centre and calendar flyout.
gpu|disable_tray_notifications.cost: You lose notification history and quick settings.
gpu|disable_tray_notifications.who: Users who never open the notification panel.
gpu|disable_tray_notifications.note: Same setting as 'Disable Action Center' on the Windows page.

gpu|disable_vsync.gain: Little or none: this flag doesn't turn off VSync.
gpu|disable_vsync.note: Turn off VSync in the game or in the NVIDIA/AMD control panel instead.

gpu|enable_bsod_verbose.why: Blue screens normally show only a sad face and a stop code.
gpu|enable_bsod_verbose.gain: Blue screens show more technical details, which helps troubleshooting.

gpu|enable_cross_device.cost: Copied text, including passwords, is kept in the history.

gpu|enable_gpu_accel.why: Makes sure WPF apps use the GPU for drawing.
gpu|enable_gpu_accel.gain: Smoother WPF apps if acceleration had been turned off.
gpu|enable_gpu_accel.cost: None; this is the Windows default.

gpu|enable_logon_verbose.why: Startup and shutdown only say 'Please wait'.
gpu|enable_logon_verbose.gain: Shows which step Windows is on, useful when startup hangs.

gpu|enable_s3_sleep.why: Modern Standby keeps the laptop partly awake while sleeping.
gpu|enable_s3_sleep.gain: Classic sleep: no surprise wake-ups or a warm laptop in the bag.
gpu|enable_s3_sleep.cost: Only works if the firmware supports S3; otherwise sleep may disappear.
gpu|enable_s3_sleep.who: Laptops that drain or heat up in standby.

gpu|force_multi_gpu.gain: Little or none: multi-GPU is up to each game.

gpu|gpu_perf_mode.gain: Can lower latency and CPU load.
gpu|gpu_perf_mode.cost: Some older games or capture tools behave worse.
gpu|gpu_perf_mode.note: Same setting as 'Enable hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling' on the Gaming page.

gpu|gpu_priority.note: Per-app GPU choice is made in Settings > Display > Graphics.

gpu|gpu_tdr_delay.why: Gives the driver longer to respond to Windows' GPU checks.
gpu|gpu_tdr_delay.gain: Fewer false driver resets under heavy load.
gpu|gpu_tdr_delay.cost: A real GPU hang takes longer to recover from.

gpu|set_utc_time.why: Windows keeps the hardware clock in local time, Linux in UTC.
gpu|set_utc_time.gain: No wrong clock after switching between Windows and Linux.
gpu|set_utc_time.cost: Only change this if you dual-boot; otherwise the clock can drift.

network|disable_autotuninglevel.why: Auto-tuning grows the TCP receive window on fast connections.
network|disable_autotuninglevel.gain: Can help with some old routers.
network|disable_autotuninglevel.cost: Downloads on fast connections can become much slower.

network|disable_ecn.why: Explicit Congestion Notification marks packets instead of dropping them.
network|disable_ecn.gain: Avoids rare problems with old routers that mishandle ECN.

network|disable_ipv6.gain: Can fix rare networks with broken IPv6.
network|disable_ipv6.cost: Microsoft doesn't support it: some Windows features, HomeGroup-era tools and IPv6-only services break, and startup can be slower.

network|disable_nagle.why: Sets TcpAckFrequency=1 on every network interface, acknowledging packets immediately.
network|disable_nagle.gain: Can lower latency in older games that use TCP.
network|disable_nagle.cost: Slightly more network overhead; most modern games use UDP and see no change.
network|disable_nagle.note: Despite the name, this changes delayed acknowledgement, not Nagle itself.

network|disable_qos.why: Sets the QoS bandwidth reserve to 0 %.
network|disable_qos.gain: Little: the reserve only applies when an app asks for QoS.

network|disable_rsc.why: Receive segment coalescing combines packets to save CPU.
network|disable_rsc.gain: Packets reach the app individually, which can lower latency slightly.
network|disable_rsc.cost: Slightly higher CPU use on fast downloads.

network|disable_rss.why: Receive-side scaling spreads network work over CPU cores.
network|disable_rss.gain: Rarely helps a misbehaving adapter driver.
network|disable_rss.cost: Network processing goes onto one core: lower throughput and higher CPU load on fast connections.

network|disable_teredo.cost: Can break Xbox Live party chat and some peer-to-peer games ('Teredo unable to qualify').
network|disable_teredo.who: PCs that don't use Xbox networking.

network|disable_timestamps.why: TCP timestamps add 12 bytes to each packet.

network|enable_tcp_nodelay.gain: Little or none: current Windows ignores this global value.

network|prefer_ipv4.gain: Connections use IPv4 when both work, which can avoid slow or broken IPv6 routes.

network|use_cloudflare_dns.why: Your provider's DNS servers can be slow or log your lookups.
network|use_cloudflare_dns.gain: Fast, privacy-focused DNS (1.1.1.1) on all physical adapters.
network|use_cloudflare_dns.cost: Some provider services or parental controls that rely on their DNS stop working.
network|use_cloudflare_dns.note: OFF sets the adapters back to automatic DNS.

personalize|accent_blue.why: Sets the accent colour to #0078D7 everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_blue.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_blue.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|accent_gold.why: Sets the accent colour to #FFB900 everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_gold.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_gold.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|accent_gray.why: Sets the accent colour to #4C4A48 everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_gray.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_gray.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|accent_green.why: Sets the accent colour to #107C10 everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_green.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_green.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|accent_lime.why: Sets the accent colour to #7FBA00 everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_lime.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_lime.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|accent_orange.why: Sets the accent colour to #CA5010 everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_orange.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_orange.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|accent_pink.why: Sets the accent colour to #E3008C everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_pink.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_pink.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|accent_purple.why: Sets the accent colour to #744DA9 everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_purple.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_purple.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|accent_red.why: Sets the accent colour to #E81123 everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_red.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_red.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|accent_teal.why: Sets the accent colour to #038387 everywhere Windows uses it.
personalize|accent_teal.gain: A matching accent colour on the taskbar, Start, window borders and apps.
personalize|accent_teal.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it, closing open Explorer windows.

personalize|clock_seconds.why: The clock shows hours and minutes only.
personalize|clock_seconds.cost: Slightly more power use on laptops.

personalize|desk_recyclebin.why: Puts the Recycle Bin on the desktop.
personalize|desk_recyclebin.gain: One click to the Recycle Bin.

personalize|desk_thispc.why: Puts This PC on the desktop.

personalize|desk_userfiles.why: Puts your user folder on the desktop.
personalize|desk_userfiles.gain: One click to your user folder.

personalize|dwm_tint.why: Some apps and the lock screen read a second copy of the tint flag.

personalize|small_icons.why: Windows 10 can use small taskbar buttons.
personalize|small_icons.gain: A thinner taskbar with more room.
personalize|small_icons.cost: Explorer restarts to apply it; Windows 11 ignores this setting.

personalize|start_frequent.why: Start can list your most used apps.
personalize|start_frequent.gain: Your top apps at the top of the list.
personalize|start_frequent.cost: Shows which apps you use most.

personalize|start_recent.why: Start and jump lists can list recently opened files.
personalize|start_recent.cost: Recent file names are visible to anyone using the PC.

personalize|taskbar_no_combine.why: Windows groups windows of the same app into one button.
personalize|taskbar_no_combine.gain: Each window gets its own labelled button.

personalize|tb_tint.why: Start and the taskbar are grey by default.
personalize|tb_tint.gain: Start, taskbar and notification centre in your accent colour.
personalize|tb_tint.cost: Works only in dark mode for the taskbar on Windows 11.

personalize|tray_all_icons.why: Windows hides new tray icons behind an arrow.
personalize|tray_all_icons.cost: A crowded tray if many apps run.

power|disable_adaptive_bright.gain: Brightness stays where you set it.
power|disable_adaptive_bright.cost: No automatic dimming in dark rooms.
power|disable_adaptive_bright.who: Laptops and tablets with a light sensor.

power|disable_bw_saving.why: Windows limits network packets for non-multimedia apps while media plays.
power|disable_bw_saving.gain: No network throttling during audio/video playback.
power|disable_bw_saving.cost: Slightly more CPU use while media plays.
power|disable_bw_saving.who: Gamers who stream or play music.

power|disable_connected_standby.why: Modern Standby keeps the PC partly awake while asleep.
power|disable_connected_standby.cost: On PCs without S3 support, sleep may disappear altogether.

power|disable_hiberboot.why: Fast Startup hibernates the kernel instead of fully shutting down.
power|disable_hiberboot.gain: A real full shutdown every time, which avoids some driver and dual-boot problems.
power|disable_hiberboot.cost: Slower startup; hibernation is also turned off.

power|disable_hibernate.why: Hibernation keeps a large file on the system drive.
power|disable_hibernate.cost: No hibernate option, and Fast Startup is turned off.

power|disable_hybrid_sleep.why: Hybrid sleep also writes memory to disk when sleeping.
power|disable_hybrid_sleep.gain: Faster sleep and less disk writing.
power|disable_hybrid_sleep.cost: Unsaved work is lost if power fails during sleep; hibernation is also turned off.

power|disable_selective_suspend.why: Individual USB devices can be suspended when idle.
power|disable_selective_suspend.gain: Mice, headsets and DACs don't drop out.

power|disable_sleep.why: Stops the PC going to sleep on its own when plugged in.
power|disable_sleep.gain: Long tasks keep running when you're away.
power|disable_sleep.cost: More power use; hibernation is also turned off.
power|disable_sleep.who: Desktop PCs left running on purpose.

power|disable_store_auto.why: Store apps update themselves in the background.
power|disable_store_auto.cost: Store apps stop getting fixes until you update them in the Store.
power|disable_store_auto.note: Same setting as on the Windows page.

power|disable_throttle_state.why: Lets the plan stop using processor throttle states.

power|disable_usb_power_save.why: USB hubs can power down idle ports.
power|disable_usb_power_save.gain: Fewer USB disconnects with audio interfaces and controllers.
power|disable_usb_power_save.who: Desktop PCs with USB audio or controllers.

power|disable_wake_timers.why: Scheduled tasks can wake the PC from sleep.
power|disable_wake_timers.gain: The PC doesn't wake up by itself at night.
power|disable_wake_timers.cost: Updates and maintenance wait until you use the PC.

power|disk_timeout.why: Hard drives spin down after a while to save power.
power|disk_timeout.gain: No delay when a sleeping hard drive spins back up.
power|disk_timeout.cost: Slightly more power use and drive wear; no effect on SSDs.
power|disk_timeout.who: PCs with hard drives used for games or media.

power|display_timeout.why: The screen turns off after a few idle minutes.
power|display_timeout.gain: The screen stays on during long downloads or while watching.
power|display_timeout.cost: More power use; risk of burn-in on OLED screens.
power|display_timeout.who: Users who turn the screen off themselves.

power|enable_fast_startup.why: Fast Startup hibernates the kernel at shutdown.
power|enable_fast_startup.cost: Some driver updates need a restart rather than a shutdown; dual-boot drives can be locked.

power|lid_close_action.why: Closing the lid normally sleeps the laptop.
power|lid_close_action.gain: Keeps running with the lid closed when plugged in, for external monitors.
power|lid_close_action.cost: The laptop can overheat in a bag if you forget.

power|power_button_action.why: Pressing the power button normally shuts down or sleeps.
power|power_button_action.cost: You must shut down from Start.
power|power_button_action.who: PCs with an easy-to-hit power button.

power|ultimate_power.why: Ultimate Performance removes the last power-saving delays.
power|ultimate_power.cost: Highest idle power use and heat.

power|usb_dma.why: Kernel DMA Protection policy for external devices.
power|usb_dma.gain: External devices that don't support DMA remapping are blocked until you sign in, protecting against DMA attacks.
power|usb_dma.cost: Some Thunderbolt/USB4 docks and devices may not work until signed in, or at all.

privacy|privacy_account_info.why: Store apps can ask for your name and picture.
privacy|privacy_account_info.gain: No Store app on your account gets your name and picture.
privacy|privacy_account_info.cost: Apps can't show your account name or picture.
privacy|privacy_account_info.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_activity.why: Store apps can ask for your activity history.
privacy|privacy_activity.gain: No Store app on your account gets your activity history.
privacy|privacy_activity.cost: Apps can't read your activity history.
privacy|privacy_activity.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_app_diagnostics.why: Store apps can ask for other apps' diagnostic info.
privacy|privacy_app_diagnostics.gain: No Store app on your account gets other apps' diagnostic info.
privacy|privacy_app_diagnostics.cost: Some system and support apps can't see which apps are running.
privacy|privacy_app_diagnostics.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_background_apps.why: Store apps keep running in the background.
privacy|privacy_background_apps.cost: Store apps stop notifying you until you open them.
privacy|privacy_background_apps.who: PCs that don't rely on Store app notifications.

privacy|privacy_bluetooth.why: Store apps can ask for unpaired Bluetooth devices.
privacy|privacy_bluetooth.gain: No Store app on your account gets unpaired Bluetooth devices.
privacy|privacy_bluetooth.cost: Apps can't sync with nearby unpaired devices.
privacy|privacy_bluetooth.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_calendar.why: Store apps can ask for your calendar.
privacy|privacy_calendar.gain: No Store app on your account gets your calendar.
privacy|privacy_calendar.cost: Calendar and Mail apps can't read your appointments.
privacy|privacy_calendar.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_call_history.why: Store apps can ask for call history.
privacy|privacy_call_history.gain: No Store app on your account gets call history.
privacy|privacy_call_history.cost: Phone Link can't show call history.
privacy|privacy_call_history.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_camera.why: Store apps can ask for the camera.
privacy|privacy_camera.gain: No Store app on your account gets the camera.
privacy|privacy_camera.cost: Store apps such as Camera, Teams (new) and WhatsApp can't use the camera; desktop apps may still.
privacy|privacy_camera.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_contacts.why: Store apps can ask for your contacts.
privacy|privacy_contacts.gain: No Store app on your account gets your contacts.
privacy|privacy_contacts.cost: People, Mail and chat apps can't read contacts.
privacy|privacy_contacts.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_documents.why: Store apps can ask for your Documents library.
privacy|privacy_documents.gain: No Store app on your account gets your Documents library.
privacy|privacy_documents.cost: Store apps can't open your documents without you picking them.
privacy|privacy_documents.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_email.why: Store apps can ask for your email.
privacy|privacy_email.gain: No Store app on your account gets your email.
privacy|privacy_email.cost: Apps other than your mail app can't read email.
privacy|privacy_email.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_eyetracker.why: Store apps can ask for eye trackers.
privacy|privacy_eyetracker.gain: No Store app on your account gets eye trackers.
privacy|privacy_eyetracker.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_filesystem.why: Store apps can ask for your whole file system.
privacy|privacy_filesystem.gain: No Store app on your account gets your whole file system.
privacy|privacy_filesystem.cost: Store apps that need broad file access (some editors and file managers) stop working.
privacy|privacy_filesystem.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_location.why: Store apps can ask for your location.
privacy|privacy_location.gain: No Store app on your account gets your location.
privacy|privacy_location.cost: Maps, weather and Find my device can't locate you.
privacy|privacy_location.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_messaging.why: Store apps can ask for text messages.
privacy|privacy_messaging.gain: No Store app on your account gets text messages.
privacy|privacy_messaging.cost: Phone Link and messaging apps can't read texts.
privacy|privacy_messaging.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_microphone.why: Store apps can ask for the microphone.
privacy|privacy_microphone.gain: No Store app on your account gets the microphone.
privacy|privacy_microphone.cost: Store apps can't record audio; voice chat in Store apps stops working.
privacy|privacy_microphone.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_notifications.why: Store apps can ask for your notifications.
privacy|privacy_notifications.gain: No Store app on your account gets your notifications.
privacy|privacy_notifications.cost: Apps that read notifications (e.g. Phone Link, smartwatch apps) stop working.
privacy|privacy_notifications.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_phone_calls.why: Store apps can ask for phone calls.
privacy|privacy_phone_calls.gain: No Store app on your account gets phone calls.
privacy|privacy_phone_calls.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_pictures.why: Store apps can ask for your Pictures library.
privacy|privacy_pictures.gain: No Store app on your account gets your Pictures library.
privacy|privacy_pictures.cost: Photos and other Store apps can't browse your pictures.
privacy|privacy_pictures.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_radios.why: Store apps can ask for radios.
privacy|privacy_radios.gain: No Store app on your account gets radios.
privacy|privacy_radios.cost: Apps can't turn Bluetooth or Wi-Fi on or off.
privacy|privacy_radios.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_screenshots.why: Store apps can ask for borderless screen capture.
privacy|privacy_screenshots.gain: No Store app on your account gets borderless screen capture.
privacy|privacy_screenshots.cost: Capture apps must show a yellow border while recording.
privacy|privacy_screenshots.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_tasks.why: Store apps can ask for your tasks.
privacy|privacy_tasks.gain: No Store app on your account gets your tasks.
privacy|privacy_tasks.cost: To Do and similar apps can't share tasks.
privacy|privacy_tasks.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

privacy|privacy_videos.why: Store apps can ask for your Videos library.
privacy|privacy_videos.gain: No Store app on your account gets your Videos library.
privacy|privacy_videos.cost: Store video apps can't browse your videos.
privacy|privacy_videos.who: Everyone who doesn't use that permission.

windows|best_performance.why: Turns every visual effect off at once, like 'Adjust for best performance'.
windows|best_performance.gain: The snappiest desktop on slow PCs.
windows|best_performance.cost: No animations, no thumbnails (icons only), rougher look.
windows|best_performance.note: Overlaps the single-effect tweaks; turn on one or the other.

windows|disable_actioncenter.why: Removes the notification panel if you never use it.
windows|disable_actioncenter.gain: No notification centre or quick settings flyout from the tray.
windows|disable_actioncenter.cost: You lose the notification history and the quick toggles (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Focus).
windows|disable_actioncenter.who: Users who never open the notification panel.

windows|disable_aero_peek.why: Peek shows the desktop when you hover the corner of the taskbar.
windows|disable_aero_peek.cost: No quick look at the desktop by hovering.

windows|disable_animations.why: Minimise/maximise and taskbar animations add a small delay.
windows|disable_animations.who: Users who prefer speed over effects.

windows|disable_background.why: Store apps keep running in the background to refresh tiles and notifications.
windows|disable_background.gain: Fewer background processes and less CPU and RAM use.
windows|disable_background.cost: Mail, Calendar, Phone Link and similar apps stop notifying you until you open them.
windows|disable_background.who: PCs that don't rely on Store app notifications.

windows|disable_boost.why: Turbo boost raises clocks above base speed when there's thermal room.
windows|disable_boost.cost: Noticeably lower performance in games and most apps.
windows|disable_boost.who: Laptops that overheat, or silent PCs.

windows|disable_co_creator.why: Turns off one of the suggested-content switches tied to AI features.
windows|disable_co_creator.note: This value controls suggested content; Paint's own AI tools are set inside Paint.

windows|disable_cooling.why: Active cooling speeds fans up before slowing the CPU.
windows|disable_cooling.gain: The CPU throttles less under heavy load.

windows|disable_copilot.why: Removes the Copilot sidebar from Windows.
windows|disable_copilot.cost: You can't use Copilot from the taskbar; the separate Copilot app may still work.

windows|disable_core_parking.why: Core parking puts CPU cores to sleep when load is low.
windows|disable_core_parking.gain: All cores stay ready, avoiding wake-up delays.
windows|disable_core_parking.cost: Higher idle power use and heat.

windows|disable_cortana.why: Cortana is retired on current Windows but its policy still affects search.
windows|disable_cortana.gain: Search no longer offers the Cortana assistant.

windows|disable_cstates.why: Core parking can put CPU cores to sleep in the High performance plan.
windows|disable_cstates.gain: All cores stay available, which can smooth out frame times.
windows|disable_cstates.cost: Higher idle power and heat. Only affects the High performance plan.
windows|disable_cstates.who: Desktop gaming PCs using High performance.

windows|disable_cursor_shadow.why: The pointer has a drop shadow.
windows|disable_cursor_shadow.cost: The setting writes the whole visual-effects bit mask, so other effects change too.
windows|disable_cursor_shadow.note: OFF restores your previous mask exactly.

windows|disable_defender.why: Microsoft Defender scans files as you use them, which costs some CPU and disk time.
windows|disable_defender.cost: Your PC has no real-time malware protection unless you install another antivirus. Tamper Protection usually blocks this, so it may not take effect.
windows|disable_defender.who: Only PCs with another antivirus installed.
windows|disable_defender.note: Turning off Tamper Protection first is required on current Windows; Cheetix doesn't do that for you.

windows|disable_edge_bg_win11.why: Edge can keep running after you close it.
windows|disable_edge_bg_win11.gain: Edge fully exits when closed, freeing RAM.
windows|disable_edge_bg_win11.cost: Edge starts a little slower and its notifications stop when it's closed.
windows|disable_edge_bg_win11.who: Everyone who doesn't need Edge running all the time.

windows|disable_extensions.why: Hides the .txt/.exe part of file names, as Windows does by default.
windows|disable_extensions.cost: Makes it easier to be tricked by files like 'photo.jpg.exe'.
windows|disable_extensions.who: Users who prefer the Windows default look.

windows|disable_firewall.why: The firewall blocks unwanted incoming connections.
windows|disable_firewall.gain: Games and tools that host connections work without firewall rules.
windows|disable_firewall.cost: Anything on your network (or the internet, without a router) can reach services on your PC.
windows|disable_firewall.who: Only PCs behind another firewall, for troubleshooting.

windows|disable_folder_discovery.why: Explorer guesses a folder's type and changes its columns and view.
windows|disable_folder_discovery.gain: Folders stop switching to Pictures or Music layouts by themselves.
windows|disable_folder_discovery.cost: Media folders no longer get media columns automatically.
windows|disable_folder_discovery.who: Users who like a consistent view.

windows|disable_font_smoothing.cost: Text looks jagged on most screens.

windows|disable_hetero.why: Changes how Windows spreads threads over different core types.
windows|disable_hetero.gain: Can help older games on CPUs with performance and efficiency cores.
windows|disable_hetero.cost: Newer games and apps that rely on Windows' scheduling may run worse; the effect depends on the CPU.
windows|disable_hetero.who: Intel 12th gen and newer with problem games.
windows|disable_hetero.note: Little-documented setting; test before and after.

windows|disable_hibernate.why: Hibernation keeps a file as large as a good part of your RAM on the system drive.
windows|disable_hibernate.gain: Frees several GB on C: (hiberfil.sys is deleted).
windows|disable_hibernate.cost: No hibernate option, and Fast Startup is turned off as well.
windows|disable_hibernate.who: Desktop PCs that only sleep or shut down.

windows|disable_hidden.why: Hides hidden and protected system files, as Windows does by default.
windows|disable_hidden.cost: You can't see hidden folders such as AppData without changing it back.
windows|disable_hidden.who: Users who prefer the Windows default view.

windows|disable_home_gallery.why: Explorer's Home and Gallery show recent files and photos.

windows|disable_idle.why: CPU idle states save power between bursts of work.
windows|disable_idle.cost: The CPU runs at full power all the time: much more heat and power, and less turbo headroom.

windows|disable_listbox_smooth.why: Lists scroll smoothly instead of jumping.

windows|disable_maxstate.why: Makes sure the plan allows the CPU to reach full speed.
windows|disable_maxstate.gain: No artificial cap on CPU speed.

windows|disable_menu_anim.why: Menus wait a moment before opening sub-menus.
windows|disable_menu_anim.cost: Sub-menus open as soon as the pointer passes over them, which some find jumpy.
windows|disable_menu_anim.note: This sets the menu delay to 0; the fade animation is a separate effect.

windows|disable_minstate.why: Keeps the CPU at full speed even when idle.
windows|disable_minstate.gain: No ramp-up delay when load starts.
windows|disable_minstate.cost: Higher idle power use and heat; on laptops, much shorter battery life.

windows|disable_mitigations.why: Spectre and Meltdown fixes cost some CPU performance, mainly on older Intel CPUs.
windows|disable_mitigations.gain: A few percent more speed in some workloads.
windows|disable_mitigations.cost: Your PC becomes vulnerable to these CPU attacks, including from websites.

windows|disable_onedrive_win11.why: OneDrive syncs files in the background.
windows|disable_onedrive_win11.gain: No OneDrive sync, uploads or background CPU use.
windows|disable_onedrive_win11.cost: Files stop syncing to OneDrive; files that are only in the cloud can't be opened until you turn it back on.

windows|disable_pwrthrottle.why: Power throttling slows down apps Windows thinks are in the background.
windows|disable_pwrthrottle.gain: Background apps (encoders, streaming tools) keep full speed.

windows|disable_recall.why: Recall takes regular snapshots of your screen to make them searchable.
windows|disable_recall.gain: Nothing on your screen is recorded.
windows|disable_recall.cost: You can't search your past activity with Recall.

windows|disable_remote.why: Remote Desktop accepts sign-in connections from other PCs.
windows|disable_remote.gain: Closes the Remote Desktop port to the network.
windows|disable_remote.cost: You can't connect to this PC with Remote Desktop.

windows|disable_restore.why: System Restore keeps snapshots that use disk space.
windows|disable_restore.gain: Frees the space restore points use and stops new ones.
windows|disable_restore.cost: You lose the ability to roll Windows back after a bad driver or update. Existing restore points become unusable.

windows|disable_search.why: The indexer reads your files in the background to make search fast.
windows|disable_search.gain: Less background disk and CPU activity.
windows|disable_search.cost: Start and Explorer search become much slower and can't search file contents; Outlook search is affected too.
windows|disable_search.who: Users who rarely search for files.

windows|disable_search_highlights.why: The search box shows daily trivia and web highlights.
windows|disable_search_highlights.gain: A plain search box with no web content.

windows|disable_sechealth.why: The Security Health service reports protection status to Windows Security.
windows|disable_sechealth.cost: Windows Security stops warning you when protection is off or out of date.

windows|disable_shadows.why: Sets the visual effects mode to 'Adjust for best performance'.
windows|disable_shadows.gain: Windows treats visual effects as set for speed.
windows|disable_shadows.cost: On its own this only changes the mode marker; individual effects follow when Windows reapplies it.
windows|disable_shadows.note: For all effects at once use 'Turn off all visual effects'.

windows|disable_sleep.why: Stops the PC going to sleep on its own when plugged in.
windows|disable_sleep.gain: Downloads, renders and servers keep running when you're away.
windows|disable_sleep.cost: More power use; hibernation and Fast Startup are also turned off.
windows|disable_sleep.who: Desktop PCs left running on purpose.

windows|disable_snap.why: Window snapping arranges windows when you drag them to edges.
windows|disable_snap.gain: Windows don't jump when dragged near an edge.
windows|disable_snap.cost: No snapping by dragging or with Win+arrow keys.
windows|disable_snap.who: Users who arrange windows by hand.

windows|disable_snap_layouts.why: Hovering the maximise button opens a layout picker.
windows|disable_snap_layouts.gain: No pop-up when you hover maximise.
windows|disable_snap_layouts.cost: Snap layouts are still available with Win+Z.
windows|disable_snap_layouts.who: Users who find the pop-up gets in the way.

windows|disable_speech.why: Online speech recognition sends your voice to Microsoft.
windows|disable_speech.cost: Voice typing and voice access work less well or only offline.
windows|disable_speech.who: Everyone who doesn't use voice typing.

windows|disable_spotlight.why: Spotlight downloads lock-screen pictures and tips.
windows|disable_spotlight.gain: No downloaded images or ads on the lock screen.
windows|disable_spotlight.cost: The lock screen uses a fixed picture.

windows|disable_start_bing.why: Start search sends what you type to Bing.
windows|disable_start_bing.gain: Searches stay local and results appear faster.

windows|disable_start_recommended.why: Start shows recommended files and apps.
windows|disable_start_recommended.cost: Recently opened files aren't shown in Start.

windows|disable_stickers.why: Desktop stickers is a small decoration feature.
windows|disable_stickers.cost: You can't add stickers to the desktop.

windows|disable_sticky_keys.why: Pressing Shift five times opens the Sticky Keys prompt, often during games.
windows|disable_sticky_keys.gain: No Sticky Keys pop-up in games.
windows|disable_sticky_keys.cost: The shortcut to turn Sticky Keys on is disabled; turn it on in Settings if you need it.

windows|disable_storeauto.why: Store apps update themselves in the background.
windows|disable_storeauto.cost: Store apps (including Windows parts like Photos and Calculator) stop getting fixes until you update them in the Store.
windows|disable_storeauto.who: Users on slow connections who update by hand.

windows|disable_tabs_explorer.why: Runs each Explorer window in its own process.
windows|disable_tabs_explorer.gain: A crash in one Explorer window doesn't take down the others.
windows|disable_tabs_explorer.cost: More RAM use; the tabs feature may stop working on some builds.
windows|disable_tabs_explorer.note: This value actually controls separate processes for folder windows.

windows|disable_telemetry.why: Windows sends diagnostic data to Microsoft in the background.
windows|disable_telemetry.gain: Less data sent and the Connected User Experiences service no longer runs.
windows|disable_telemetry.cost: Windows Insider builds and some troubleshooters need diagnostic data; Home and Pro still send the minimum 'required' level.
windows|disable_telemetry.who: Everyone who doesn't use Insider builds.

windows|disable_thumb_preview.why: Hovering a taskbar button shows a live preview.
windows|disable_thumb_preview.gain: No preview pop-ups (the hover delay becomes 30 seconds).
windows|disable_thumb_preview.cost: You can't preview windows from the taskbar.

windows|disable_tooltip_anim.cost: The setting writes the whole visual-effects bit mask, so other effects change too.
windows|disable_tooltip_anim.note: OFF restores your previous mask exactly.

windows|disable_transparency.why: Acrylic blur costs a little GPU work.
windows|disable_transparency.gain: Solid colours; slightly less GPU use.

windows|disable_virt.why: Virtualization-based security runs part of Windows in a hypervisor.
windows|disable_virt.gain: Can raise game performance a few percent.
windows|disable_virt.cost: Removes protection against kernel-level malware; Memory Integrity and Credential Guard stop working.
windows|disable_virt.who: Gaming PCs where you accept less protection.

windows|disable_widgets_win11.why: The widgets board loads news and weather in the background.
windows|disable_widgets_win11.gain: No widgets board or its background process.

windows|disable_window_border.why: Sets the window border padding to 0.
windows|disable_window_border.cost: Window edges can be harder to grab for resizing.

windows|disable_xbox.why: Xbox services run even if you never use Xbox apps.
windows|disable_xbox.cost: Xbox app, Game Pass games, Xbox controller accessories over the wireless adapter and Xbox sign-in in games stop working.
windows|disable_xbox.who: PCs that never use Xbox or Game Pass.

windows|enable_battery_pct.why: The tray battery icon doesn't show a number.
windows|enable_battery_pct.gain: Battery percentage next to the icon.

windows|enable_classic_menu.why: Windows 11 hides most right-click entries behind 'Show more options'.
windows|enable_classic_menu.gain: The full right-click menu opens straight away.

windows|enable_compact_mode.why: Explorer adds extra spacing between items for touch.
windows|enable_compact_mode.cost: Smaller click targets on touch screens.

windows|enable_dark_theme.gain: Dark apps and system UI, easier on the eyes at night.

windows|enable_end_task.why: Adds End task to the taskbar right-click menu.
windows|enable_end_task.gain: Close a frozen app without Task Manager.
windows|enable_end_task.cost: Ending a task loses its unsaved work.

windows|enable_numlock.why: Num Lock is off at the sign-in screen on many PCs.
windows|enable_numlock.who: Desktop keyboards with a number pad.

windows|enable_scrollbars.why: Windows 11 hides thin scrollbars until you hover.
windows|enable_scrollbars.gain: Scrollbars are always visible and easier to grab.

windows|enable_start_layout.why: Asks Start to use its earlier Windows 11 layout.
windows|enable_start_layout.gain: Start looks like the earlier version on builds that support it.
windows|enable_start_layout.cost: No effect on builds that don't support the switch.
windows|enable_start_layout.who: Users who prefer the older Start.

windows|hide_taskbar_search.why: The search box takes taskbar space.
windows|hide_taskbar_search.gain: More room for apps; press Win and type to search.

windows|hide_taskbar_taskview.why: The Task View button is easy to replace with Win+Tab.
windows|hide_taskbar_taskview.cost: No Task View button to click.

windows|high_performance.why: Balanced lets the CPU slow down when idle.
windows|high_performance.gain: Clocks ramp up faster when a game starts.
windows|high_performance.cost: Higher power use and heat at idle; on laptops, shorter battery life.

windows|left_align_taskbar_win11.gain: Start sits in the corner like Windows 10.
windows|left_align_taskbar_win11.who: Anyone who prefers the classic layout.

windows|performance_mode.why: Windows offers 'adjust for best performance' in System Properties.
windows|performance_mode.gain: Visual effects follow the performance preset.
windows|performance_mode.cost: Fonts can look rougher and windows less polished.

windows|processor_priority.why: Tells the scheduler to give the window you're using longer time slices.
windows|processor_priority.gain: The app in front gets a bit more CPU time than background work.
windows|processor_priority.cost: Background tasks like renders run slightly slower.

windows|remove_dev_home.why: Dev Home is a developer dashboard most people never open.
windows|remove_dev_home.cost: Dev Home is removed; reinstall it from the Store if you want it.
windows|remove_dev_home.note: Removing an app can't be undone automatically: reinstall it from the Microsoft Store.

windows|remove_phone_link.why: Phone Link runs in the background to connect to your phone.
windows|remove_phone_link.gain: One fewer app and background process.
windows|remove_phone_link.cost: You can't use your phone's messages, calls or photos on the PC.
windows|remove_phone_link.who: Users who don't link a phone.
windows|remove_phone_link.note: Removing an app can't be undone automatically: reinstall it from the Microsoft Store.

windows|remove_teams.why: The consumer Teams app ships with Windows 11.
windows|remove_teams.gain: One fewer app and startup item.
windows|remove_teams.cost: Teams is removed; you'd reinstall it from the Store.
windows|remove_teams.note: Removing an app can't be undone automatically: reinstall it from the Microsoft Store.

windows|set_taskbar_left.gain: Start sits in the corner like Windows 10.
windows|set_taskbar_left.who: Anyone who prefers the classic layout.
windows|set_taskbar_left.note: Same setting as 'Left-align the taskbar'; you only need one.
